verdict.rationale: ClickHouse can be installed and run on your own machine or infrastructure, which means you decide where the data physically lives. ClickHouse Cloud also lets you export backups to your own cloud account. However, nothing in the evidence documents choosing a region or residency setting for managed Cloud services, so residency control is shown only through self-hosting and backup export. Missing for 10: documented ClickHouse Cloud region/residency selection, data-residency or compliance guarantees, independent corroboration of residency controls.
